item.title: One in five victims in Netherlands experience victim blaming, study finds
item.description: One in five victims in the Netherlands reports experiencing victim blaming, according to a study released by Slachtofferhulp Nederland on Sunday, the European Day of the Victim.

item.title: Netherlands finishes third on Winter Olympics medal table, sets national gold record
item.description: The Netherlands finished third on the medal table at the 2026 Winter Olympics, achieving its highest-ever ranking at the Games.

item.title: One wounded in shooting at crowded Arnhem mall; Suspect arrested
item.description: A shooting inside a crowded shopping mall in Arnhem injured one person Saturday afternoon, and police later fired a warning shot while arresting a suspect outside the complex, authorities said.

item.title: Video: Woman severely injured in Boxtel home stabbing; 62-year-old woman arrested
item.description: A woman was seriously injured Sunday after being stabbed at her home on Annastraat in Boxtel. The victim was opening her front door when the attack occurred.

item.title: Top two stand firm: PSV and Feyenoord overcome early goals to secure wins
item.description: Feyenoord solidified their second place in the Eredivisie with a hard-fought victory over 17th-place Telstar. The Rotterdammers won 2-1 thanks to two goals from Anis Hadj Moussa.

item.title: Dutch home prices up 5.4% to average €493,875 in January
item.description: Home prices increased by an average of 5.4 percent in January compared to a year earlier, Statistics Netherlands (CBS) reported based on data from the Land Registry.

item.title: Video: Head-on collision in Zaandam leaves eight hurt, including three children
item.description: Eight people were injured in a head-on collision between two vehicles in Zaandam on Sunday evening.
